story.vex: Beat the lock quietly, and nothing else even notices. My favorite kind of entry. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: every entry point that could be quietly beaten now has a way to notice if it is. Astro: "Locks buy time. Detection is what tells us the time ran out."

ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read coverage-audit.txt: four entry points. Classify each as covered or detection-gap.

1. type coverage-audit.txt
2. classify <entry> covered | detection-gap

entry-main-hall       solid lock, CCTV covers it, alarm wired and monitored

steps.title: Read the coverage audit
steps.body: Volt: "Read every entry point before judging any." `type coverage-audit.txt`.

steps.title: Flag every detection gap
steps.body: Volt: "A lock with nothing watching it if it fails is a gap, no matter how solid the lock is." Classify all four entry points.
